stem_book: What is the tension in a massless string with 10 N force applied (at each end)? (a) 10 N (b) 5 N (c) 0 N (d) Depends on length
reason: Print is vague ('with 10 N force applied'); added 'at each end' so the string is in equilibrium and T is unambiguous.
work: massless string: net force must be 0 ⇒ tension equals the applied pull = 10 N throughout
